nodes.name: diff-scope-and-image-preservation.md
nodes.summary: Architecture audit of diff scoping, composer reload, and image-preservation control flow, covering simulatorAtom scope/nonce atoms, SessionReplay diffScope, ChatPanel compact-file-data hooks, and the actions.ts image-preservation helpers; concludes 0 blocking issues with a clean concern-split and a legitimate dedup extraction.

nodes.name: per-round-file-list.md
